## Description {#details}

To convert constants into recognised typed operands, the framework provides several literal operators within the dedicated <code>literals</code> namespace.

Similarly, for dynamic values, wrappers are available to convert them into recognised types.


<SectionUser title="Examples">

</SectionUser>


<ProgramListing extension="cpp">

<CodeLine><Highlight kind="normal">mt::expect (mt::to&#95;i &#123;answer&#125; == 42<Link to="/docs/api/namespaces/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/#a1613ccf081248c601bed0f3022fba652">&#95;i</Link>);</Highlight></CodeLine>
<CodeLine><Highlight kind="normal">mt::expect (mt::to&#95;f &#123;expression&#125; == 42<Link to="/docs/api/namespaces/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/#adcff4454bf86ea03c0c3d1be42b04e12">&#95;f</Link>);</Highlight></CodeLine>

</ProgramListing>
